official_documentation_checked.api: Java SE 25 module and package overview
official_documentation_checked.finding: No standard PDF document parser API is documented in the Java SE module inventory.
Supplies file bytes or a stream; does not interpret PDF objects or pages.
Lists application/pdf as possible preformatted print data, with no mandatory DocFlavor support or PDF page parsing result.
Plugin based image reader API; Java SE does not document a bundled PDF reader plugin.

limit: This is an official Java SE 25 API inventory, scoped to bundled standard APIs. A third-party ImageIO plugin or platform print service can add PDF support; neither becomes a JDK parser. No standard API had a documented PDF-aware local input and observable page result to run on the control.
